company_info.company_description: "Our workmanship is second to none with customer service being our number 1 priority. We never outsource our work to ensure we can control the quality of our installations and our SAA accredited installers follow strict processes to ensure customer satisfaction from start to finish. At Solar Air Energy we provide affordable and tailored energy solutions for you and your family."

reviews.review_description: Was very happy with the quote process and all information provided. Once we went ahead the wait time was not too long. Installation went well, they were on time and very tidy.

My system was installed just over 12 months ago and I couldn't be happier. I wanted to wait until I'd had it a year and I'd seen how it operated under all conditions and all seasons, and had experiences with after-sales service, before leaving a review.Smooth process all the way through, from the initial contact to follow up queries, installation and advice post-installation. Anthony was knowledgeable, patient during the quotation process with my stream of questions and quick to provide extra information upon request.The installation team were great, and when I identified they had forgotten to install bird netting around the panels, the office quickly arranged for them to be back within a couple of days. The team helped to set up the battery app on the day of the install and walked me through how it all worked. They also helped to organise the grid connection and explained the process clearly.I had problems with an inverter fault only a few weeks in, and on a Saturday afternoon. I was able to speak to Anthony the same day despite it being a weekend, and the team looked into the issue within 24 hours - it was a firmware issue and they resolved it quickly.There's been some wild weather this year and I had no problems with my panels or battery during the high winds and rain  with ex-Cyclone Alfred and some other severe storms. I called Anthony ahead of the cyclone to see if I should shut down my system as there was so much conflicting information online and appreciated his advice. Solar Air Energy also sent out an email to customers with advice about systems and cyclones, which I appreciated.Highly recommend the Solar Air Energy team.

The team consisted of Nathan, Mark and Dylan. They were very professional, polite, punctual and worked through the day to complete our installation. Nathan helped us with liaising with our roofer regarding existing cracked / damaged roof tiles and we are very grateful for his help with this issue. Nathan looked after us a lot that day. Everything was explained as the job progressed and Mark made sure my wife and I understood how everything worked and how to adjust the timer and use the app. Very happy with how everything worked out and would recommend Solar Air Energy to anyone getting new solar fitted to their property.
Friendly efficient professional company to deal with.I recommend them with no hesitation.

From start to finish, Nathan and the team did an amazing job installing solar panels and a battery at our home. We can’t recommend them highly enough. They’re known as the best for a reason. Highly recommended.

All the team from Solar Air Energy were fantastic, from sales (very responsive and friendly) to installers (great workmanship, clean, explained everything and answered politely to all my questions to admin staff  accommodated to additional requirements from the bank for the green upgrade loan).Great experience. System is working well

From enquiry to quoting , sales,  installation & after service ....fantastic service from Nathan, Gail  & all the other staff.We install Solar panels 3 yrs ago & have never  looked back with their services. Very knowledgeable & always hand on to advise & help.Now we install  batteries for our Solar & same fantastic service. Both products from Solar panels, Inverter to Batteries are  very  good quality brand. There were no problems with the system & save heaps on electricity  bill.We highly  highly  recommend  Solar Air to everyone.Thank you  Solar AirThank you Guys for everything n we will continue  to use your  service

We received 2 quotes as requested from SolarQuotes who made the process easy and gave great information. The 2 companies that visited our home were both great but we chose SolarAirEnergy at Morningside to do our installation. From first contact, this company was very professional and knowledgeable, tailoring a system to suit us. There was no pressure selling (not a cricket legend in sight) and no problem giving us quotes for different systems as we weighed up our needs and budget. The sales people and installers were second to none and the installation went quickly and smoothly. The system looks so tidy on our roof and we had a power outage a week after install when a local power pole collapsed, our battery kept our fridges and lights going until sun up. I would highly recommend SolarQuotes website as you start your solar journey and highly recommend SolarAirEnergy  as a trusted and switched on installation company.

Jack, Josh, Harry and Brodi were extremely professional.The installation is very simple to use and explained really well to me.The installation is very clean/neat and tidy up after the installation was completed.I highly recommend Solar Air Energy if you are seriously considering a Solar investment.

We first enquired after having a look on the web in our local area. The team were quick to make contact and were out to our home within the next week. Our site visit went very smoothly and all my questions were answered on the spot. After accepting the quote we were booked in and ready to have the solar install. The install went so quickly and the boys were a delight to have at our home. We will be recommending Solar Air Energy to our friends in the future.

The team at Solar Air energy have been so easy to deal with from start to finish. All my questions were answered with great knowledge, the installers turned up on time and upon completion explained the app and showed me what I should be looking for.

Couldn’t recommend Solar Air Energy enough! From the very first appointment with Nathan, who explained thoroughly the system that was best suited for us, not just to cover our need but also our budget. To the ladies in the office which were helpful and polite, to the crew that came out to install! The guys Jack. Dylan, Myles and Brodie were punctual, friendly, funny but very professional. The after sales service was definitely helpful and fantastic.There are so many dodgy solar companies out there now and I found the process easier and more confident going with this company.Thankyou so much!!

We sourced 3 companies for quotes. Solar Air Energy provided the best value for money, perfectly tailored to our families needs. From start to finish, their team went above and beyond. The crew arrived on time, were friendly, answered all our questions, and left everything spotless. The solar system which also includes a battery is performing exactly as promised, and we’re now in credit with our power bills. The guys helped us set the app up on our phone so we can watch it in real time. We couldn’t be happier!

Had a great chat with the girls in the office , they called me straight away to book Anthony in for a site visit he answered all our questions and let a us know how the installation will happen, the boys turned up and did a great job , showed us how to use the app. Highly recommend them

After receiving 3 quotes we proceeded with Solar Air Energy and I could not be happier. We have had our system for nearly 2 years now and have not had a power bill since having it installed. We use to get $800 quarterly bills however since having the Solar Installed we have been in credit since. We limit our usage to mostly during the day so have been fortunate to not have too much night time usage however with the feed in Tariff dropping we have started looking into a Sungrow Battery which we will 100% be getting Solar Air Energy to Install when the time is right. They also installed a Hot Water timer to help us save more money and ran us through the system after install to ensure we understood everything but have also been amazing with any questions we have had since the install also. Would absolutely recommend Solar Air Energy to anyone looking for a great quality system with 10/10 amazing after sale service. They have been back after the first 12 months to clean the panels and do a full health check on the system and answer any questions my husband and I had.
Had Nathan out to do a site visit, he was very honest  didn’t beat around the bush, explained everything, help me understand how to read the power bill correctly, made going with them easy.
Nathan and the team did an amazing job, from start to finish, the boys on site did a great job, were all so polite, highly recommend these guys

We’ve put off getting solar for ages as we felt overwhelmed by the process. Solar Air Energy has made it so easy for us!! The process was extremely simple, they worked with us to make sure we could get it financed and wasn’t more expensive than our current electricity bill. Install was a breeze and the team were lovely to deal with from start to finish. Super happy!! So glad we finally ripped the bandaid off, our electricity bill is next to nothing now.
Fantastic business very happy with their quality services and products. Fast, efficient and friendly - highly recommended A+
The guys were thorough and professional. Good advice coupled with a great product and after sale service.
Great customer service. Provided honest recommendations and didn’t try and oversell. Communication was great and installers were punctual. No problems with the whole process.

We couldn’t have been happier with the quality of service and the system installed. From quoting to installation, everyone involved was very polite and punctual. We have been bragging about our new system to everyone. Highly recommend Solar Air if you are considering getting a new system installed.

Solar Air Energy have exceeded all expectations, From the initial site visit to the installation of the solar. The boys were polite whilst completing the install and explained everything upon completion. The system has made a big difference already and I would highly recommend Solar Air Energy to anyone looking at getting Solar in the future.

Very happy with the service provided by Anthony and the install team at Solar Air Energy. Anthony was always available and responsive to the many questions that I had regarding the system, installation and the app. The installation was quick, the app is simple to use, and the system is working great. I would highly recommend anyone looking to get solar to get in touch with the team at Solar Air Energy.

Easy to deal with, friendly staff and answered all my questions. They are quite local to my location and proactive in monitoring any issues. Price was on par with 2 other quotes I got for a quality inverter and solar panel brand.

Thanks to the SAE team - Nathan, Tom, Jack, Joshy, Dylan and Corey.  What a great team. Really efficient friendly and informative. I would happily recommend them to other for a Solar System install. From quote to completion the whole team including the office was exceptional. Thanks!
Customer service was excellent and the online app makes tracking our usage so easy.

Couldn’t recommend this company enough. Corey and Nathan both went above and beyond to ensure our solar was installed efficiently and in a timely manor.They were polite and professional, always keeping us informed of their progress. Highly recommend!

Called Nathan from a friends recommendation, and what a great recommendation it was. His customer service from the start was amazing. The team that came out and installed were very professional and friendly. Once installed the guys went through everything to get going. I’ve since used Solar air energy for other electrical work including moving some panels to make way a new patio and again service was fantastic. Highly recommend!!

Quoting process was great and they attended in person. Installation was on time. Demonstration was provided and the solar has been working well. Only negative was that three tiles were cracked on removal of old system with the installer promising to replace with spares we had. Instead we were advised the next day by a different installer that they would repair the tiles instead which is not ideal. Overall I would recommend this company.

We were very happy with the solar and battery system installed by Solar Air Energy. They were professional and responsive in understanding our requirements and investigating options for locating the equipment and cable runs, for a neat end result. The installation went smoothly, with the site left clean. The system (and iSolarCloud app) is easy to use, and easy to understand consumption and production data. Nice people to deal with too. Highly recommend.

The sales process was carried out very professionally and questions were answered usually with a personal visit by a company representative of which we were very impressed.Installation was carried out with minimum of fuss; the installers were very tidy and conscious of the garden when using ladders to access the roof.All the arrangements for connections were carried out by the company and did not require me to oversee anything.A charger was not required to be installed but the battery installation was also carried out very professionally.

Have just had a solar system with battery installed by Solar Air Energy. Given the number of providers out there, I tried to do as much research as possible.Spoke to a few providers and Solar Air Energy were happy to answer all my questions. Quote maximised my bang for buck.Once I decided on Solar Air Energy (based on reviews and comparing their quote with others), the process was pretty quick.The team on the day of install were very professional and took time to answer my stupid questions and clarifying my concerns. The whole install was done in about 8 hours and they left the place spotless.It’s only been two days, but already I am generating more power than I am using (and slightly more than the quote suggested I would make). The real time app is a life saver.I would definitely recommend the addition of a battery if you can manage it - makes a HUGE difference.And I would thoroughly recommend Solar Air Energy as a provider. They have made the process smooth and worry free.

It is now two years since we had a 7 kw 3 phase system installed at our home by Solar Air Energy. This installation has been trouble free over that time, following a well organised quotation process, and then an installation team who excelled themselves in carrying out their work. Based on our experience we would not hesitate in recommending Solar Air Energy  to undertake solar system installation for you.A very satisfied customer.
Sales and quoting was efficient and a good range of convincing information was provided.

Quoting process was okay. No problem.We had two salesman visited us at home ,so we had a chance to talk through and ask questions.Installation was very good , quick and professional.They came on right time.Customer service was very good , no problem.

Every aspect was very professional. The install was quick and installers were friendly and educational. Great customer service when I needed after sales advice. I highly recommend Solar Air Energy for your Solar needs.
Prompt and personal  sales service.Punctual and accommodating installation team.
Installed as per quote.Work quality during the installation was at the required high standard.Customer service approach of installation team was amiable and factual.

First up, Nathan was very thorough in working out what solar system would work best for us and explaining how everything worked. He answered all my questions and addressed my concerns about battery safety. Gail was on the phone straight away to organise a time...and reorganise it when we had to get a new roof installed first! Then Jack, Seth, Jack, Mark and Myles arrived and had our system up and running by 2pm. They were professional, efficient and very neat with the installation, and they cleaned up afterwards really well. I am super happy with the system. It is an impressive piece of kit and It has vastly exceeded my expectations. Nathan is helping us with the network and grid connection process which makes life easier.I have to say, the REC 410 Alpha Pure R work exceptionally well and easily meet our power needs.  The Sungrow 10Kw SH10RS inverter is a marvel and manages to keep our power usage from the Energex grid at zero almost all the time.
Great service and installation system has not missed a beat

The quoting process was very thorough and answered all my questions. Even when I changed my mind on part of the quote, Solar Air Energy quickly amended the quote for me. The installation was unreal. The team was so efficient, professional and tidy and the installation looks great. At the end of the job they explained everything to my partner and made sure there was nothing that they hadn't discussed. I would gladly recommend Solar Air Energy to anyone.

The whole process from receiving the initial contact from Solar Air to the installation of the system was simple and efficient.  Each step was done/delivered on time and, as an existing solar system was being replaced, the government  and site requirements were clearly explained in order to select the best option.  The members of the installation were friendly and efficient, assisted with the installation of the app and the site was left clean and tidy.

We've had the team work on our house several times over the years.Couldn't be more happy with the service, products and after sales service.The batteries, solar panels and all the electrical works have been awesome.The Team supports our annual solar panel cleans and system checks, to ensure the system is 100% efficient.Thanks Team!!

I used them for the original solar installation and a year later now with the home battery setup. Both times their team were fantastic and very knowledgeable, what I really love is that they offer you professional advise and recommendations, including their honesty when making recommendations to not to do something, if they feel you're not getting going to get the full benefit (and not just chasing a sale). Highly recommend the team and I will certainly be using them again in the future.

I found the team very helpful in navigating through the selection of systems and size. The installation also coordinated with me for removal of the old system, then waited for roof repairs before installing the new system. The team were happy to schedule around other work on my house that suited my timing.

From sales/quote process though to installation and customer service years later, it was a breeze. They ensure their customers are well informed of solar issues and any discrepancies on bills, educating us on how it works etc! I honestly couldn’t fault anything throughout the whole process. The team are amazing and you get what you pay for.

From start to finish the process of having a new solar system installed was so simple.  A quote was provided promptly, the installation process went very smoothly and the team was professional, polite, punctual and tidy. The post-installation service was also excellent, explaining system operation in a user-friendly way and that any faults would be detected their end to address. I’ve been really pleased, and the performance of the system in significantly cutting my energy bills has been fantastic.

From the quote to instillation, one of the best business that I have ever had a job done for me. I have to praise Nathan for his after instillation follow up. Nothing was too much bother for him to sort out. Couldn’t recommend this business enough. If I could give 6 stars, I would.

From start to finish was so easy and comprehensive. Quote given immediately with full explanation of the whole process but not once were we pressured to sign up there and then. Installers were on time, introduced themselves a nd so polite and answered all our questions. Great explanation of how the system works and then follow up phone call to ensure we were happy. Looking forward to our savings. We highly recommend Solar Air Energy as all that was discussed was delivered. Thanks 10 out of 10

I was looking for an installation that was a bit outside the norm. After discussing it with Solar Air Energy they were very keen and positive. We've ended up with a quality system expertly installed. Customer service was great and everything was taken care of.Highly recommended.

We installed a replacement solar system with SolarAirEnergy.It was a smooth and trouble-free process from start to finish. Anthony who came to give us a quote and managed to make a small but significant change to our hot water settings before we even agreed to the work, Corey & Brodie who removed the old panels and installed the new panels, and Tom and Jack who returned with the right smart meter - every one was friendly, professional, efficient and tidy!!We are really happy with changeover and the novelty of being able to see exactly what the system is doing and how we are using power hasn't worn off yet!!

After the severe storm that hit the Gold Coast on Christmas day  evening, we lost a few roof tiles and were concerned the Solar Panels may have been damaged thus affecting the operation of our 4 year old System. After contacting Solar Air Energy they promptly sent  2 Technicians and after a thorough examination and cleaning of the Panels and updating of the Inverter software, they pronounced the system was in perfect working order.What is even more amazing is that this work took several hours and was carried out at no charge to us!Well done Solar Air Energy and thankyou for your assistance.

Nathan and his team have done 2 systems for me now on 2 homes, always on time, coordinated, polite, courteous and get the job done properly. They left the job clean and tidy both times and follow up service is great too.

Anthony was great to deal with, very professional and very honest!Installation was very quick and professional, very friendly and helpful tradesmen.Excellent customer service, great company to deal with!

We would like to highly recommend Solar Air Energy for their services and installation.  We had a battery system and Ducted air conditioner installed.  Seemless to the end! Thankyou the guys from the install team- Brodie, Tom, Jack, Josh, Dylan, Corey and Nathan!

Solar Air Energy delivered an exceptional service. From dealing with Anthony for the planning, to the team attending on the day, the whole process was seamless.The installation team Brodie, Jack, Tom, Josh, Myles, Dylan and Jack were all incredible. They did the installation quickly and we were so happy with the results. The installation was all to a very high standard.With professional guidance from start to finish, and excellent post-installation support, we highly recommend Solar Air Energy for anyone looking for solar or electrical work.Thanks again team!

Nathan Bill, arrived exactly  on time in his working gear to quote a price and information/advice, impressed me that there was no sales pitch or over promising during the quoting dance.I have over time researched  solar electricity/hot water and have never really been impressed. I decided to look at the solar electricity side from an econometrics point of view.I may add I have a iStore hot water system fitted now that comes on at 1300h and runs for approximately 45minutes.I rarely respond to surveys etc, but the team SAE has a professional outfit. This is how this all happened, I was referred to SAE by a friend, he had a complete system/battery installed by SAE and I  was impressed by his install.I originally had two roof solar hot water services fitted to the roof over time, should have learnt the first time to not do this but at the time there was not a lot of options. The ongoing costs to service them is not a good feeling to the wallet!SAE were here at 0700h and installed a 8.8kw complete system, along with removal of existing solar hot waster service on the roof, gone by 1300h's.As per the normal instructions from government advice, I Googled and engaged two other quotes, not even close to SAE's.The tradies he has are in my option about as good as you can get, really impressed with their instal. The App was set up and explained to us how it worked and what to expect, rained for a week after installation but still had a good k/w input.Three weeks later a Sungrow 9.6kw battery was added, again a professional fit and 3k under the nearest quote!The instal was on the 7th February,  now 12th April. The complete system is working above my expectations and I am very pleased that I had this fitted and current results.To date  I am in credit with Origin. The average daily yield  has been 37.5kw, consumption approximately 15.6kw/day. The Sungrow battery is usually 100% by 1000h.Our intention is to insulate ourselves from the growing electricity costs by adding to battery back up shortly.

Sales | Quoting Process:  Very prompt and knowledge at time of quoting.  Answered all our questions explaining the different options.Installation:  Very punctual, polite and friendly, neat and tidy job on the roof.  Guys cleaned up after themselves too.Customer Service:  Was great, right thru to grid connection.Highly recommend Solar Air Energy for the Solar.... can't beat their customer service!
Yes the quoting process was excellent as was the installation on a hot sunny day by competent men.
Very happy with the customer service and installation process with solar air . My parents recommended them and I have now recommended their services to several friends!Highly recommend!

We used Solar Air Energy for our new solar system and electrical works. We could not be happier with the end result. From initial consultation, communication in between and delivery on the day. The install team were very professional and well mannered. Cleaned up before they left and made sure we were happy with everything.I would highly recommend the team at Solar Air!

From start to finish solar air energy were easy to deal with, The installation was carried out to a very high standard keeping me informed all the way. Once finished the site was cleaned up.They ran through on how to use the app.

Nathan and the team are exceptional. They are the only people in solar we will ever deal with. They are honest, hardworking, down to earth. From the moment Nathan came around to quote, through to installation and after service the team has been exceptional.

The team at Solar Air Energy were great from the quote, through to install day, and after as well, very approachable and I am pleased with their level of customer service. The install team worked hard and left a neat job, the electrical work is fantastic, and I needed new meters, switchboard work and new switchboard at front of the property (all quotes I got noted this requirement) and our home is much safer after the electrical work they did. I recommend getting in touch with them to see what they can do for you.

My replacement solar system was an insurance job and right from the start everything went smoothly.  Four employees, Mark ,Tom, Myles and Josh arrived on time with all equipment needed. The installation was done competently, it was fully explained to me by the boys. Photos were taken.  All the old gear was removed and left out place spotless.An app was installed on my iPhone and Tom explained how to use it.I am very happy with SolarAir, a very professional company.

Nathan & Gail from Solar Air Energy were very efficient in their reply to all of our questions about the Solar Panels.My husband & I always feel at ease when speaking to Nathan.Gail was always so polite to me & always return my calls, sms texts & emails on the same day.We were never pressured to purchase the Solar Panels when the quotes were send.Nathan was so honest in answering all our questions & explaining everything.Nathan organized all the installation & paper work .  The installation of our Solar Panels were done in a day.All our needs for the Solar Panels were met & we are very happy with the service provided by Nathan & his staff at Solar Air Energy.I highly recommend Solar Air EnergyThank you Nathan & Gail

From the first quote to the final sign off, Solar Air Energy, are a professional group, knowledgeable with what they do.The installation, from start to finish was accomplished with punctuality and care, the tradesmen are polite and considerate and any after service  problems are looked after quickly and professionally.Great group, great guys.

Quoting process was so easy. Nathan provided all our options and also gave personal opinions which wasn’t a pushy sales pitch. All the team at Solar air energy are great, not just tidy but fabulous tradesmen. A year after our install, I noticed we were getting bills from our energy provider. After a quick phone call to Nathan to discuss,  it was discovered there had been an issue with Energex for a year which was causing system issues. If we didn’t have the handy sungrow app we would be none the wiser. Again, well done Solar air energy.

Our whole experience from the quote with Anthony, talking on the phone to Gale and then the install by Jack, Jacko, Josh and Tom has been A+ quality. Everything has run smoothly and now it's installed my family and I can't wait to see what our new energy freedom will bring us. Would highly recommend and will use again in the future

The team at Solar Air Energy were a delight to work with. From initial contact and quotation to installation of our solar system; the process was seamless. Highly recommend Solar Air Energy for your solar needs.

When Jack, Myles, Corey and Nathan arrived to install our solar system they could not have been more orgamised, professional and friendly.  We had received multiple quotes from other companies but they were soon forgotten when we received a quote from Nathan at Solar Air Energy,   Nathan soon made us feel comfortable and confident that we had made the right decision.  They use their own in house teams and don't sub out the work which we really liked.  The whole team simply over deliver in customer service and professionalism.  The system is great too, we are definately going to be saving some money on our power bills.  Also the system has been installed to be battery ready.  Thank you to the whole team at Solar Air Energy.Thanks againJeff and Therese

It has been a little over 12 months since the installation of solar to our home 32 Longhi panels and Sungrow inverters (battery ready).The service we have received to date is nothing short of exemplary.   Nathan’s consultation (at our home) and quotation process was informative and thorough.  We had 3 factors which needed to be met (a) Cost (b) product quality/reliability (c) a company which had their own crew for install and we could easily maintain contact with company post installation. Tick, tick, tick.We were very impressed with the crew who did the installation.  Team work at its best, they worked like Trojans, were friendly, polite and meticulously cleaned up before leaving.They installed and setup the app on our phones, arranged for Energex sign off and gave us tips for what to consider when choosing a supplier eg tariffs and Feed In rate conditions ie some suppliers have a higher FI cents/kw but are capped vs lower FI cents/kw unlimited.Love how we can monitor the performance of the solar and can 100% say getting solar has been a good decision.Unbeknown to us, last week, we didn’t notice our wifi connection to the inverters had dropped out which prevented the solar app from monitoring.  However, gratefully we received an email from Solar Air Energy which alerted us there was an issue, what to do and we were back online in no time. Thank you Solar Air Energy.Communication from all levels has been fantastic, from sales and admin, to install and after sales.We were super delighted to learn Solar Air Energy not only do Solar but also air conditioning and any thing electrical (which we have now used to perform other in home electrical needs and to service our ducted AC ).I have no hesitation in singing their praises and frequently recommend Solar Air Energy to my own clients and friends who are interested in getting solar for their home.

We had our system installed back in 2022 and since having it installed we have not had a power bill. We are currently in credit of $900! The monitoring is great to be able to make sure our usage is under what our system is producing. Very happy with the system and the installation was seamless, the boys cleaned up after themselves and ran through the app on my phone to make sure I understood everything. They have contacted me twice when my wifi dropped out to get the system back online! The after sales customer support is amazing! Highly recommend Solar Air Energy to anyone looking for a good quality install from a reputable company!

Contacted a number of suppliers for Solar, Solar Air Energy were the only ones who viewed my property prior to quoting. Went through all options available with pricing.After consultation I had a better understanding of Solar. Happy with my choice & after sale service has also been amazing.End up ordering:Solar System Details:6.6kW Solar SystemSungrow InverterCanadian PanelsPrice: $8,100
All went well with replacement and install of a new system.

The sales process was very smooth and everything was explained to our satisfaction.  When the installation was done everything went to plan and the installers arrived at the appointed time and cleaned up after the job was completed.  We were very happy with the customer service and they did organise the grid connection after the install and helped us through the WIFI configuration.  We like the convenience of being able to control the panel from our phones whether at home or away from the premises.

Nathan & the team were nothing but friendly and professional from the first time we met to discuss our options, installation day and after service. He gave us options and recommendations for what would best suit our household and family. Friendly team, efficient and great product! Couldn’t recommend them enough!

Solar Air Energy were referred to us by a friend who had their system installed by Solar Air Energy a few years ago and couldn't speak more highly of them and their after sales customer service! We went from $500 quarterly bills to now being in credit! The guys were very friendly and professional and cleaned up after themselves. They ran through the monitoring and showed us how the system works which was very much appreciated!

Great customer service and very knowledgeable on the process and products they have available. Installers were friendly and efficient however my husband had to spend the next day cleaning up after them as we did find a lot of screws and leftover bits metal etc left laying around and we have small child. Due to my vision impairment I didn’t notice it or I would have asked them to tidy better.

We were referred to Solar Air Energy for Air Conditioners and then ended up getting them to do Our Solar all of our Air Conditioners and Electrical work at our new home. From the initial site visit until the system was installed we were very impressed with the company. The system has been on over a year now and we are extremely happy with how it is performing we are getting credits most quarters which is amazing! Couldn't recommend the team at Solar Air Energy more highly!

Nathan & his team did an amazing job, communication was clear & efficient. We had our solar installed within a week of confirmation. Definitely recommend Solar Air Energy to anyone looking to have solar installed on their property.
The quote was very competitive.The installation was hassle free.The installers were polite, punctual and friendly.
Quoting for our solar installation was very professional and clear.Installation was efficient and tidily done.Everything was organised and connected.No issues at all.
Everything from start to finish was such a seamless process. Would highly recommend. Great affordable product and still high quality.

We got our solar installed about 6 months ago now and I hadn't left a review as I wanted to see how the system performed. I am extremely happy with the performance of the system we are no longer getting bills at all and are in credit! The monitoring on the App is great we had a bit of trouble when we changed over internet providers and the Solar Air Energy team came back out and got our monitoring back online for us! The service provided before during and even after the installation has been fantastic and I am so glad we went with Solar Air Energy!

Solar Air Energy Installed our Solar System in September of 2023 since then we have been receiving credits on our bills each month even during summer whilst running our Ducted Air Conditioning. The removed our existing system and allowed us time to have our roof painted prior to installing our new system. The team were polite and professional I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a great system with great after sales service!

I recently had a solar installation done from Solar Air Energy, and I am very pleased with the results. The key points that stood out:Great Customer Service: From the initial consultation to the final installation, the customer service was exceptional. The team was responsive, knowledgeable, and patient in answering all my questions.
